candidates.title: Project-wide continuation and cross-dialog learning
candidates.problem_or_opportunity: Strong improvements were being trapped in isolated project conversations and required repeated Founder nudges to continue.
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Project-wide delta harvest, persisted state restoration, promotion of stronger compatible reusable mechanisms, and continuation until a real gate.
candidates.expected_benefit: Cumulative learning across dialogs with less duplicated work and less context loss.
pilot_evidence: Cross-dialog state/autopilot/current-router integration exists in GitHub and Drive
red_team_findings: Newer sibling implementation strengthened the law with freshness sweep, concurrent-dialog rebase and stale-work gate; those improvements were preserved rather than overwritten
verification_evidence: Persisted GitHub authority and Drive mirrors verified during 2026-08-21 integration
candidates.next_action: Continue enforcing at every substantial project boot and feed new candidates into this registry.

candidates.title: Cross-dialog Delta Harvest / Portability Scout
candidates.problem_or_opportunity: The system could create a new universal mechanism without first checking whether a stronger version already existed in another project/dialog.
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Before new universal design: discover newer artifacts, verify provenance/status/version/hash/gates, abstract portable mechanism, classify and promote only after comparison/Red Team.
candidates.expected_benefit: Reduces duplicate routers, stale reinvention and loss of stronger neighboring work.
pilot_evidence: Used successfully when Founder-approved continuation law was integrated without overwriting newer sibling-dialog v1.2 improvements
verification_evidence: Current GitHub router contains Cross-Dialog Delta Harvest behavior
protected_authorities: No silent promotion from chat memory
candidates.next_action: Run before designing any new universal mechanism or adapter.

candidates.title: Transactional targeted/global repair mechanisms from Story Recovery

source_provenance.notes: Lists bounded mechanisms allowed for inheritance while recovery package remains non-authority

candidates.problem_or_opportunity: Repairs can corrupt accepted work, invalidate too much, or cosmetically fix downstream symptoms instead of the earliest failing layer.
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Patch queue/contract, semantic candidate delta, separate QA, transaction snapshot/rollback, selective descendant rebuild, global-before-local order, canon reapproval boundary, no-effect rejection.
candidates.expected_benefit: Safer bounded repair with less collateral rewriting.

known_promotion_blockers: Full Story Engine v4.1 Reference Intelligence runtime

pilot_evidence: Recovery v0.5 persisted as WORKING candidate with 130/130 engineering tests according to current system state
red_team_findings: Higher test count does not authorize promotion of the whole recovery engine
application_targets: Narrative OS targeted repair standards where bounded mechanisms are independently accepted
candidates.next_action: Inherit individual mechanisms only when a live production problem demonstrates need and the bounded mechanism passes current regression gates.
candidates.hold_trigger: A current production defect requiring one of the bounded repair mechanisms, or completion of recovery promotion blockers.
candidates.terminal_reason: Held as upgrade candidate; not rejected.
candidates.notes: Explicitly prevents accidental promotion of recovery candidate as whole current engine.

candidates.title: Bounded cross-model handoff with disposition and provenance
candidates.problem_or_opportunity: Different AIs could create parallel canons, repeat work, or return advice that disappears or is applied without reconciliation.
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Bounded RUN CARD/AGENT_PACKET, independent review where useful, recommendation disposition ACCEPT/ACCEPT_WITH_MODIFICATION/HOLD_FOR_TEST/REJECT, apply to controlling artifact, persist provenance and tests.
candidates.expected_benefit: Uses multiple models as evidence-producing specialists while maintaining one shared project state.
pilot_evidence: Current cross-AI handoff and router already use the bounded packet/disposition model
red_team_findings: Duplicate model opinion is not independent evidence if models share the same source/conclusion chain
protected_authorities: External model output is candidate evidence, not canon
candidates.next_action: Use for all substantive Claude/Grok/GPT/other-model handoffs and record dispositions.

candidates.title: Shared musical fact / motif identity across audio paths

source_provenance.notes: Current universal audio consistency gate according to system state

candidates.problem_or_opportunity: One plot-relevant musical fact generated independently through voice/performance/SFX/music paths can become internally inconsistent.
candidates.proposed_mechanism: All clue-bearing pitched/rhythmic events inherit a shared musical identity contract and are verified post-render.
candidates.expected_benefit: Prevents clue-breaking contradictions across production buses/providers.
pilot_evidence: ROOM 917 forensic production evidence recorded in current system state
application_targets: Current universal audio production authority and projects with plot-relevant musical facts
verification_evidence: CURRENT_IVDIVO_SYSTEM_STATE.json marks the contract integrated current universal audio consistency gate
candidates.next_action: Apply only when a project contains a repeated plot-relevant musical fact or motif.
candidates.notes: Example of project discovery correctly promoted to reusable domain mechanism without importing ROOM 917 canon.

candidates.title: Self-improvement engine and anti-loss registry v1

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 directive: develop a self-improvement engine so best ideas are recorded, developed and applied instead of lost in dialog chaos

candidates.problem_or_opportunity: The project has many useful ideas and improvements but no single lifecycle guaranteeing capture, development, testing, promotion, application and verification.
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Central improvement registry with anti-loss invariants, lifecycle state machine, dedupe, development contract, pilot/canary, promotion/application map, monitoring and rollback.
candidates.expected_benefit: Turns fragmented project discoveries into cumulative verified system evolution while preserving story-first production.
red_team_findings: Must not become an endless meta-work loop that starves actual books
Must not auto-promote attractive ideas without evidence
Must support pruning and rollback, not only accumulation
candidates.next_action: Retain as historical/base implementation while v2 candidate is evaluated and promoted.
candidates.notes: Initial implementation; v2 extends its scope and priority architecture.

candidates.title: Self-Improvement Meta Engine v2 — books first, audio second, whole factory learning

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 directive: self-improvement must apply to everything, first writing books and making audio novels, then productivity, problem solving, engine creation, research and continuous improvement

candidates.problem_or_opportunity: v1 prevented idea loss but did not explicitly govern the entire production factory around the ordered priorities of book quality/completion, book-to-audio transformation, productivity, engine/tool improvement and continuous research.
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Three coupled loops (Book, Book-to-Audio, Meta-Learning), ordered P0-P6 objective stack, problem mining, Best-Candidate Router, WIP anti-bedlam guard, research engine, book/audio/productivity sensors, multi-AI improvement cell, deployment/readback/rollback, real-product feedback, knowledge pruning and self-reference control.
candidates.expected_benefit: Makes system evolution directly serve stronger completed books and better audio novels while improving the full factory without losing ideas or drowning production in meta-work.

acceptance_conditions: Exact utility runtime smoke when checkout available

pilot_evidence: v2 was integrated using freshness/rebase checks rather than overwriting concurrent schema-1.4 system-state progress
Writing router now points to v2
Drive engine/router mirrors created and populated
red_team_findings: Meta-work can starve actual books unless WIP/priority guards exist
A single score can hide tradeoffs; ordered objectives and qualitative priority bands are safer
Audio learning must not become permission to rewrite locked story
Research can become endless unless it has a decision and stopping rule
Self-improvement itself must be subject to the same promotion/rollback gates
candidates.next_action: Read back v2 GitHub and Drive pointers, safely rebase aggregate CURRENT_IVDIVO_SYSTEM_STATE to v2, then run promotion review; exact utility runtime remains a separate provisional gate until executable checkout is available.
candidates.notes: Founder-priority expansion: books first, audio second, whole-factory learning after those priorities.
